POINTER, not a cache file. This path held a 0-byte file from the day the item was
first ingested, because the Internet Archive scan of the "Seventh Annual Report of
the Current Camp Committee" (10 December 1900) carries no OCR text layer -- the
document is cursive manuscript and no OCR was going to read it.

The eight page images were read by eye and transcribed on 2026-09-06 (p_288). The
transcript is at:

    sources/cache/ymca-montreal-fonds/1900-12-10-seventh-annual-report-current-camp-committee.txt

(note the shorter filename: no "of-the"). Source record:
src_ia_seventh_annual_report_current_camp_1900. See facts f_4879 to f_4885.

This file is left in place, rather than deleted, because the empty version was what
anyone grepping the cache found for years, and a pointer is more use than an absence.
